6118.en: In the plane of a triangle ABC, let A′B′C′ be the outer Vecten triangle, and let :g:`M_{A}M_{B}M_{C} << M_A M_B M_C >>` be the medial triangle. Let O_{A} be the circumcenter of triangle :g:`B'C'M_{A} << B' C' M_A >>`, and define O_{B} and O_{C} cyclically. Let O'_{A} be the point, other than A′, in which the circles :g:`A'B'M_{C} << A' B' M_C >>` and :g:`C'A'M_{B} << C' A' M_B >>` meet, and define O'_{B} and O'_{C} cyclically. The six points O_{A}, O_{B}, O_{C}, O'_{A}, O'_{B}, O'_{C} lie on a circle, here named the 1st Dao-Vecten circle. If the construction is carried out using the inner Vecten triangle for A′B′C′, the resulting six points line on the 2nd Dao-Vecten circle. (Thanh Oai Dao, November 4, 2014).

The **2nd Lucas secondary tangents triangle** is the triangle having sidelines N_{A}, N_{B}, N_{C}. The 1st and 2nd Lucas secondary tangents triangles are perspective, and their perspector is X_6199. Moreover, the six touch points of the Lucas circles and Lucas secondary circles lie on a circle, here introduced as the **Lucas secondary tangents circle**, with center X_6409.
